data.summary: The figures for revenue ($130.5B, +114.2% from $60.9B), net income ($72.9B), total assets ($111.6B) and cash ($8.6B) are correct. Operating income is wrong: the text says $33.0B, but the reported FY2025 figure is about $81.5B.
